## Public-data safety

- [ ] Tests and examples use synthetic data.
- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, private code, model transcripts, raw
      telemetry, provider session data, `.lattice/`, generated artifacts, or
      unreviewed recordings are included.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated for observable behavior.
